'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Another job for you, warrior. Ever heard of the Cardinal residential complex? That's where you'll be headed. I want to send my boys in, but first we've gotta clear out all the local trash. Think of yourself as the neighborhood cop crashing a rowdy house party.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 20 any target using [[Weapons#Assault rifles|Assault rifles]] or [[Weapons#Assault carbines|Assault carbines]] on [[Streets of Tarkov]]

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Already heard you got the job done. Good work, soldier!}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill any 20 targets on [[Streets of Tarkov]] while using [[Weapons#Assault rifles|Assault rifles]] or [[Weapons#Assault carbines|Assault carbines]].
